name: Upright piano
definition: acoustic piano with a vertical frame and strings, hammers striking the strings from the front.

name: Grand piano
definition: acoustic piano with a horizontal frame and strings in a wing-shaped case; grand size is an attribute.

name: Digital piano
definition: electronic keyboard instrument made to reproduce the piano, with a weighted or piano-style action and built-in sound.

name: Harpsichord
definition: keyboard instrument whose strings are plucked by quills or plectra.

name: Pipe organ
definition: keyboard instrument sounding through ranks of pipes fed by wind, including church and chamber organs also played outside worship.

name: Tonewheel organ
definition: electromechanical organ that generates its tones with rotating tonewheels.

name: Synthesizer
definition: electronic instrument that generates sound with its own engine and is played or sequenced as a whole unit; `form_factor` (keyboard, desktop module, rack module) and synthesis method are attributes (memo "keyboard synthesizer", renamed by section 14 E3-3a).

name: Modular synthesizer module
definition: single synthesizer function built to be mounted with others in one mount system (the format, such as Eurorack, is a C13 platform row).

name: Drum machine
definition: electronic instrument that produces drum and percussion sounds and plays them from a built-in sequencer.

name: Sampler
definition: electronic instrument that records, stores and plays back sound samples from its pads or keys.

name: Theremin
definition: electronic instrument played without contact, pitch and volume set by the hands' distance from two antennas.

name: Groovebox
definition: all-in-one instrument combining synth, drum and sample voices with a built-in pattern sequencer, sold as a groovebox (section 14 E3-3b, provisional).

name: Solid-body electric guitar
definition: electric guitar with a solid body and magnetic pickups.

name: Semi-hollow electric guitar
definition: electric guitar with a hollow body around a solid centre block.

name: Hollow-body electric guitar
definition: electric guitar with a fully hollow, archtop-style body.

name: Steel-string acoustic guitar
definition: acoustic guitar with a hollow body strung with steel strings.

name: Classical guitar
definition: acoustic guitar with a wide neck strung with nylon or gut strings.

name: Resonator guitar
definition: acoustic guitar whose sound is projected by one or more metal resonator cones.

name: Bass guitar
definition: electric or acoustic fretted bass instrument tuned an octave below the guitar's lowest strings.

name: Ukulele
definition: small four-string plucked lute of the guitar family.

name: Banjo
definition: plucked lute with a drum-like membrane soundtable on a round frame.

name: Mandolin
definition: small plucked lute with paired strings, usually tuned in fifths.

name: Oud (short-necked fretless lute)
definition: short-necked, fretless, pear-bodied plucked lute; region tag; level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Sitar (long-necked plucked lute)
definition: long-necked plucked lute with movable frets and sympathetic strings; region tag India; kind by E-4, level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Shamisen (three-string lute)
definition: long-necked, three-string plucked lute with a skin-covered body; region tag Japan; level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Koto (long zither)
definition: long board zither with movable bridges under each string; region tag Japan; kind by E-4, level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Guzheng (long zither)
definition: long board zither with movable bridges; region tag China; a kind only if CV-27 holds, otherwise a non-maker named form under koto (E3.1.5.01); provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Harp
definition: plucked string instrument whose strings run from a soundboard to a neck at an angle, in an open or framed body.

name: Violin
definition: four-string bowed instrument held under the chin, the treble of the violin family; fractional size is an attribute.

name: Viola
definition: four-string bowed instrument held under the chin, larger and lower than the violin.

name: Cello
definition: four-string bowed instrument played seated with an endpin, the tenor-bass of the violin family.

name: Double bass (upright bass, contrabass)
definition: largest and lowest bowed string instrument, played standing or on a high stool.

name: Flute
definition: transverse flute sounded by blowing across an embouchure hole.

name: B-flat clarinet
definition: single-reed clarinet pitched in B-flat.

name: Bass clarinet
definition: single-reed clarinet pitched an octave below the B-flat clarinet, with its own body and mouthpiece.

name: Soprano saxophone
definition: single-reed saxophone of the soprano voice.

name: Alto saxophone
definition: single-reed saxophone of the alto voice.

name: Tenor saxophone
definition: single-reed saxophone of the tenor voice.

name: Baritone saxophone
definition: single-reed saxophone of the baritone voice.

name: Oboe
definition: double-reed woodwind with a conical bore.

name: Bagpipes
definition: reed pipes (chanter and drones) sounded from a bag of air; regional variants are named forms with a region tag.

name: Trumpet
definition: valved brass instrument in the treble range with a mostly cylindrical bore.

name: Trombone
definition: brass instrument whose pitch is changed mainly with a slide.

name: French horn (horn)
definition: valved brass instrument with a coiled conical tube and a wide flared bell.

name: Tuba
definition: largest and lowest valved brass instrument.

name: Harmonica
definition: mouth-blown free-reed instrument with reeds in a row of channels.

name: Accordion
definition: bellows-driven free-reed instrument with keyboard or buttons and bass buttons; bayan and garmon are named forms with a region tag (E-4, E-20).

name: Concertina
definition: small bellows-driven free-reed instrument with buttons on both ends.

name: Harmonium
definition: free-reed instrument with a keyboard and hand- or foot-pumped bellows; E3 also when played in worship (step 14 note).

name: Melodica
definition: mouth-blown free-reed instrument played from a small keyboard.

name: Shruti box
definition: bellows-driven free-reed drone instrument without a keyboard.

name: Acoustic drum kit
definition: set of acoustic drums (and usually cymbals and hardware) played by one drummer.

name: Electronic drum kit
definition: drum kit of pads or mesh heads that trigger electronic sounds from a sound module.

name: Snare drum
definition: shallow double-headed drum with snare wires across the lower head.

name: Crash cymbal
definition: cymbal made for loud accents.

name: Ride cymbal
definition: large cymbal made for a sustained ride pattern.

name: Hi-hat cymbal
definition: pair of cymbals mounted on a stand and closed by a pedal (sold as a pair).

name: Splash cymbal
definition: small, thin cymbal with a short, quick decay.

name: China cymbal
definition: cymbal with an upturned edge and a trashy, cutting tone.

name: Cajon (box drum)
definition: box-shaped wooden drum played by hand while sitting on it; level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Djembe (goblet drum)
definition: goblet-shaped hand drum with a skin head; level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Timpani
definition: tuned kettle drum with a bowl-shaped shell, played with mallets.

name: Marimba
definition: tuned mallet percussion instrument with wooden bars and resonators.

name: Singing bowl
definition: standing bowl bell sounded by striking or rubbing the rim; E3 unless made for a rite (K-110).

name: Music box
definition: mechanism that plays a tune by a pinned cylinder or disc plucking a tuned steel comb.

name: Barrel organ
definition: organ played mechanically by turning a pinned barrel.

name: Musical saw
definition: saw blade bent and bowed or struck to sound a sustained tone.

name: Glass harmonica
definition: set of graded glass bowls on a spindle, sounded by rubbing the rims with wet fingers.

name: Combo amp
definition: instrument amplifier and loudspeaker in one cabinet; circuit technology (tube, solid-state, modelling, hybrid), wattage and speaker size are attributes.

name: Amp head
definition: instrument amplifier without a loudspeaker, made to drive a separate cabinet.

name: Speaker cabinet
definition: loudspeaker enclosure made to be driven by an amp head.

name: Amp modeller
definition: floor or desktop unit that carries amplifier models (usually with effects) in place of an amplifier.

name: Distortion effect
definition: unit that clips the instrument signal hard for a distorted sound; format (pedal, rack, desktop) is an attribute.

name: Overdrive effect
definition: unit that clips the signal softly to emulate a driven amplifier.

name: Delay effect
definition: unit that repeats the signal after a set time.

name: Multi-effects processor
definition: unit offering several effect types in one housing and no amplifier models.

name: Large-diaphragm condenser microphone
definition: condenser microphone with a large capsule, sold for recording music; connectivity (USB, XLR) is an attribute.

name: Dynamic microphone
definition: moving-coil microphone sold for music on stage or in the studio.

name: Wireless microphone system
definition: microphone or bodypack transmitter with its receiver, sold for music performance.

name: Audio interface
definition: external unit that converts microphone and instrument signals for recording music on a computer (K-150).

name: Mixer
definition: console that combines, levels and routes several audio channels; analogue or digital and channel count are attributes.

name: Studio monitor
definition: near-field loudspeaker cabinet made for monitoring in recording and mixing.

name: PA speaker
definition: pole-mount or flown loudspeaker cabinet made for live sound; powered or passive is an attribute.

name: Studio headphones
definition: headphones sold by their maker as studio, stage or DJ equipment.

name: In-ear monitor system
definition: stage in-ear monitoring kit with a transmitter and a bodypack receiver (K-143); provisional until attested.

name: DI box
definition: direct-input box that converts an instrument signal to a balanced microphone-level signal.

name: DJ controller
definition: control surface with jog wheels, faders and pads for DJ software.

name: DJ turntable
definition: direct-drive record turntable sold for DJ performance.

name: MIDI keyboard controller
definition: keyboard that makes no sound of its own and sends MIDI or other control data to sound sources.

name: Pad controller
definition: grid or bank of pads that sends control data to software or hardware, for beat-making, recording or DJing alike.

name: Guitar strings
definition: set or single string made for a guitar or bass.

name: Guitar case
definition: hard or soft case made to hold one guitar or bass.

name: Drumstick
definition: stick made for playing drums and cymbals, sold as a pair.

name: Music stand
definition: stand that holds sheet music or a tablet at reading height for the player.

name: Metronome
definition: device that sounds or shows a steady, settable beat.

name: Tuner
definition: device that shows how far a played note is from the target pitch.

name: Practice mute
definition: mute that quiets an instrument for practice, made for several instruments.
